stages.title: Statistics with R
can: I can choose between a t-test, a chi-squared test and a regression
I can explain what a p-value and a confidence interval mean
I can fit a linear model in R and read its output

quiz.q: Which compares the means of two independent groups?
In lm(weight ~ height, data = df), what is being modelled?
A p-value of 0.03 means…
options: there's a 3% chance the null hypothesis is true
if there were no effect, data this extreme would turn up about 3% of the time
97% of repeats will find the same

quiz.q: Why look at residuals after fitting a linear model?
options: to check the model's assumptions (shape, spread, outliers)
